title: Von Miller wants to play in 2026, has 'lobbied' Broncos HC Sean Payton

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Von Miller wants to play in 2026, has 'lobbied' Broncos HC Sean Payton
sources.description: Von Miller was the MVP of Super Bowl 50 with the Broncos. He's lobbying to return to Denver for 2026.
